```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: voting-app
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-secret
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: db-secret
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: postgres
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
  POSTGRES_DB: postgres

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: db-pvc
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: db-pvc
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: db
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
        app.kubernetes.io/name: db
        app.kubernetes.io/component: database
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: db-secret
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
              name: postgres
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - postgres
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - postgres
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: db-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: db-pvc

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: db
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
      name: postgres
  selector:
    app: db

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/component: cache
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/component: cache
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
              name: redis
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/component: cache
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
      name: redis
  selector:
    app: redis

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vote
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote
        app.kubernetes.io/name: vote
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: vote
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_vote:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              name: http
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vote
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      name: http
  selector:
    app: vote

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: result
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: result
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: result
        app.kubernetes.io/name: result
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: result
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_result:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              name: http
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: result
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      name: http
  selector:
    app: result

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: voting-app
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: worker
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
        app.kubernetes.io/name: worker
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: example-voting-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_worker:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
```
